editorial:
Imagine spending your workdays rubbing elbows with the biggest stars in the world, but instead of glamorous parties, you see them at their weirdest moments. That is exactly what you get here. Andrew Richter takes you behind the scenes of the luxury hotel world, sharing stories that feel like juicy gossip from a coworker you actually like. The vibe is very relaxed and funny, making you feel like you are just sitting in a lounge listening to a friend tell wild tales about celebrity meltdowns and strange requests.

What really works is how Andrew tells these stories; he does not judge the stars, he just finds the humor in the chaos. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the stories are a bit more believable than others. If you love hearing about the secret lives of the rich and famous, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with Andrew reflecting on how fame changes people. He shares one final, shocking story about a major star who was surprisingly kind, which balances out the weirder tales. He ends by explaining that no matter how famous someone is, they are still just human beings with flaws. The film closes with a montage of hotel life, leaving you with the feeling that the real magic happens behind closed doors.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves celebrity gossip and behind-the-scenes stories.
